description: Summarize a ROS 2 bag at `path` as a `BagAnalysis`: storage format, duration, message count, per-topic stats and `mode_effective`. Per topic `frequency_hz` is `(n - 1) / (last - first message time)` (`frequency_basis` `topic_span`), with `first_timestamp_ns`, `last_timestamp_ns` and `latched`; a latched topic whose messages all fall within 1 s (e.g. `/tf_static`) has a null `frequency_hz`. When the bag cannot be read locally or the bounded scan (8 s) is cut, the rate falls back to count / bag duration (`bag_duration`) and `note` says why. `anomalies` lists observed clock steps, silences of steady topics and TF edges, and backward header stamps (topic, time offset, size, no cause); empty means none found by these checks, not clean, and `note` says if the scan was cut or skipped. **Live mode** runs `ros2 bag info`, or `rosbags` without `ros2` or when it fails (`reader` says which); **mock mode** returns fixtures for any bag-like path. **Raises an MCP error** for a missing path, a directory without `metadata.yaml` or an unreadable bag. **Duration**: ROS lock, one call at a time, ends within 45 s; `busy` if held.

path.description: Bag path: a `.mcap`, `.db3` or ROS 1 `.bag` file or a `rosbag2_*` directory (with its `metadata.yaml`). Existence and format are checked live; mock accepts any well-formed path.

name: analyze_bag

first_timestamp_ns.description: Recorded ns of the first message; `null` for text-only summaries or no messages.

frequency_basis.description: `topic_span` (accurate) or `bag_duration` (count over the whole bag, understates late topics); `null` without a rate.

frequency_hz.description: (count - 1) / the topic's own span (`frequency_basis`); `null` under 2 messages, zero span or a latched 1 s burst.

last_timestamp_ns.description: Recorded ns of the last message; same rules.

latched.description: True if recorded with transient_local durability, false if volatile, `null` without QoS information.

message_count.description: Number of messages recorded on this topic across the bag.

outputSchema.description: Structured summary of a ROS2 bag, from `ros2 bag info`, `rosbags` or a mock fixture.

anomalies.description: Observed clock steps, silences, backward stamps. Empty: none found by these checks, not clean (`note`).

message_count.description: Total number of messages across all recorded topics.

note.description: Why the result is less detailed than usual (e.g. rates over the whole bag duration); else `None`.

reader.description: What produced this summary: `ros2 bag info`, the `rosbags` library or a mock fixture.

start_ns.description: Record ns of the bag's first message (rosbag2 `starting_time`), the zero of `start_s`/`end_s`; `null` if unreadable.

storage_format.description: `mcap`, `sqlite3`, or other storage identifier when known.

topics.description: Per-topic statistics for every topic present in the bag.

outputSchema.title: BagAnalysis

title: Analyze bag
